failureRules.remoteReadFailure: preserve local state and pending queue; allow a later authorized retry
failureRules.remoteWriteFailure: preserve local state and pending queue; do not claim convergence
failureRules.partialHydration: do not install partial application state
failureRules.unauthorized: do not hydrate or mutate cloud-backed application state

historicalInvariants: completed transactions are immutable historical records unless an explicit business correction workflow exists
future master-price changes never rewrite historical order prices
reports for closed periods are snapshots, not live views of mutable current settings
derived projections may be rebuilt from canonical child resources without losing historical identity

ownershipRules.businessModules: feature modules mutate through the state/persistence boundary; they do not become sync coordinators

upgradeRules: no second application-state store may be introduced
no feature may bypass GVSync for synchronization scheduling
no feature may bypass GVData for Supabase transport
new synchronized collections must be registered centrally before use
new relational collections must define canonical parent/child ownership and reconciliation behavior
production changes require preview certification before release
each sprint must ship with deterministic automated regression evidence
